title: "{{< fa calendar >}} Schedule"
jupyter: python3
execute:
  # This page reads sta-363-f26-schedule.csv and checks which source files
  # exist. freeze only watches the .qmd, so a cached schedule goes stale the
  # moment the CSV changes or a new deck, exercise or problem set is added.
  freeze: false
---

The timeline of topics and assignments may be updated during the semester.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import os
import pandas as pd

d = pd.read_csv("sta-363-f26-schedule.csv").fillna("")

LAPTOP = '<i class="fa-solid fa-laptop"></i>'
USERS = '<i class="fa-solid fa-users"></i>'
FILE = '<i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines"></i>'

COLAB = "https://colab.research.google.com/github/LucyMcGowan/sta-363-f26/blob/main/"


def link(path, icon):
    """Icon linking to the rendered page, or to Colab for a notebook.

    Greyed out when the source file does not exist yet, so the schedule can
    list the whole semester without students clicking through to a 404.
    """
    if not path or not os.path.exists(path):
        return f'<span class="dim">{icon}</span>'
    if path.endswith(".ipynb"):
        return f'<a href="{COLAB}{path}" target="_blank">{icon}</a>'
    return f'<a href="{path.replace(".qmd", ".html")}">{icon}</a>'


rows = []
last_week = None
for _, r in d.iterrows():
    week = "" if r["week"] == last_week else r["week"]
    last_week = r["week"]
    tag = f'<span class="assessment">{r["assessment"]}</span>' if r["assessment"] else ""
    rows.append(
        "<tr>"
        f'<td class="wk">{week}</td>'
        f'<td class="dt">{r["date"]}</td>'
        f'<td class="tp">{r["topic"]}</td>'
        f'<td class="ic">{link(r["slides"], LAPTOP)}</td>'
        f'<td class="ic">{link(r["appex"], USERS)}</td>'
        f'<td class="ic">{link(r["assignment"], FILE)}</td>'
        f'<td class="as">{tag}</td>'
        f'<td class="pr">{r["prepare"]}</td>'
        "</tr>"
    )

head = (
    "<tr><th>Week</th><th>Date</th><th>Topic</th>"
    "<th>Slides</th><th>AE</th><th>PS</th>"
    "<th>Assessment</th><th>Prepare</th></tr>"
)

# a raw html block, so Pandoc passes it through rather than reparsing it and
# turning every <i> icon into an <em>
print("::: {=html}")
print('<table class="schedule"><thead>' + head + "</thead><tbody>")
print("".join(rows))
print("</tbody></table>")
print(":::")
```
